session_summary: Completed GET-only, >=1 req/sec cross-instance sampling of 11 Platform Rijksoverheid Online assets. All valid targets use the same apex HTTP -> apex HTTPS -> www HTTPS redirect pattern; /admin, /user/login, /jsonapi, and /api are uniformly 404; robots and sitemaps are 200. No exposed management/test surface, sensitive data, or reportable configuration leak was found.
dead_ends: wave5-pro.md spells caorijk.nl as caorrijk.nl; the latter does not resolve and is absent from program.csv. The authoritative CSV target www.caorijk.nl was sampled successfully.
Security-header differences are family/site allowlist differences without demonstrated impact and are ineligible by themselves.
The bilingual NederlandWereldwijd pair exposes /api/manifest?v=3, but validation showed only a small public PWA manifest; government.nl control returned 404.
